# HAVIT — Your AI weight loss coach. Everything in one app.

> AI weight loss coach for iOS and Android. Log a meal in seconds; HAVI, the in-app coach, reads your weight, body composition, sleep and GLP-1 trends together and tells you the one thing to do today. Works with or without GLP-1 medication. Published by Havit Inc.

HAVIT replaces the stack of single-purpose apps a weight-loss attempt usually needs. Meals, hydration, workouts, sleep, steps, cycle, mood and GLP-1 doses are logged in one place, and HAVI turns that log into one concrete next step each day instead of another dashboard of numbers. The program was built by professionals formerly at Juvis Diet, a leading Korean metabolic weight-management clinic, and was tested in a 12-week clinical study with Eulji University where results were measured on InBody rather than self-reported.

www.aihavit.com is the marketing site (one home page per language, plus the blog and the legal documents). The product itself is the HAVIT mobile app.

HAVIT is a wellness app, not a medical device. Body composition figures are statistical estimates, not clinical measurements. HAVIT does not diagnose, treat or prevent disease, and does not give medication advice — dose and side-effect decisions belong with a qualified healthcare professional.

## What the App Does

- **AI Coach (HAVI)** — reads what you ate, how you moved and how you are trending, then gives one clear next step. Ask it anything, any time: meals, plateaus, cravings.
- **Nutrition** — photograph a meal for an estimated calorie and nutrient breakdown.
- **Daily missions** — behavior-change techniques turned into small repeatable actions, with streaks and visible progress.
- **Body insights** — estimated body composition and wellness trends over time, not just scale weight.
- **Daily check-in** — condition, sleep, appetite and mood in a few taps; HAVI returns one focus for the day and why it is the right call.
- **Mind & recovery** — guided meditation for cravings, sleep, calm, focus, breathing and gratitude, plus workout videos and 1,400+ articles in Discovery.
- **Tracking** — meals, hydration, workouts, sleep, steps, cycle, mood and GLP-1 in a single app.

## Evidence

- [Clinical results](https://www.aihavit.com/#study): 12-week clinical study with Eulji University, June–August 2026. 78 participants analysed (HAVIT 41, control 37), InBody measured at week 1 and week 12. 5%+ weight loss: 31.7% vs 8.1% (3.9×, p=0.012). Lower body-fat percentage: 83% vs 49% (p=0.002). Unblinded; individual results vary.
- Body composition model: 92.9% estimated agreement with InBody readings in an internal study with Eulji University (n=70).
- [User stories](https://www.aihavit.com/#stories): reviews from study participants and beta users. Individual experiences and results vary.

## Languages

The home page is served in 34 locales: English at the root and 33 localized paths (`/ko/`, `/ja/`, `/de/`, `/es/`, `/fr/`, `/pt/`, `/it/`, `/nl/`, `/pl/`, `/ru/`, `/uk/`, `/tr/`, `/ar/`, `/he/`, `/hi/`, `/id/`, `/ms/`, `/th/`, `/vi/`, `/zh-cn/`, `/zh-tw/`, `/ca/`, `/cs/`, `/da/`, `/el/`, `/fi/`, `/hr/`, `/hu/`, `/nb/`, `/ro/`, `/sk/`, `/sv/`, `/uz/`). The app itself is localized into 35 languages.

The Korean page carries a different lead than the other locales: it leads with the team's origin at Juvis Diet (`쥬비스 출신이 만든 AI 다이어트`) because that clinic is a recognised brand in Korea. The product described is the same one.
